source.name: BBC Sport, "Chelsea: club announce USDC shirt sponsorship deal with Circle" (Nizaar Kinsella)
source.quote: Chelsea have announced a new one-year front-of-shirt sponsorship deal with Circle Internet Group.

note: USDC stablecoin branding; replaces the front that had been vacant. One-year deal; the value is 'believed to be about £50m per season, though the exact figures have not been given' (same article) — so the amount is a reported estimate, not an official figure.
